address: 2F, Gate 8, West 3 Building, Tengda Shopping Mall, 1800 Donghai Avenue, Jiaojiang, Taizhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: This loafy, spacious area, conveniently located in the CBD, is divided into various zones. The chef and part of the kitchen team hail from Guangdong. In addition to dim sum, Cantonese barbecue, seafood and stir-fries, the score also rolls out a few Jiangzhe dishes to cater to the local palate. Crispy skin pigeon boasts juicy, silky flesh; har gow is beautifully pleated and generously filled with firm, snappy shrimps.
